title: Project
description: The project.json file at the root of a '<Name>.aura' project directory, and the payload returned by create_project / open_project and emitted on 'project://changed'. All paths inside are relative to the .aura directory (POSIX separators) so projects stay portable.

schemaVersion.description: project.json format version; this document describes version 1.

name.description: Project display name (usually the directory name without '.aura').

path.description: Absolute path of the .aura directory on THIS machine. Informational; rewritten on open, never used for intra-project references.

sampleRate.description: Project sample rate in Hz; the unit for every *Samples field in the project and IPC surface.

tempoBpm.description: Project tempo in beats per minute (single global tempo in v1).

timeSignature.description: Global time signature as [beatsPerBar, beatUnit], e.g. [4, 4].

clips.description: All clips across all tracks (flat list; clip.trackId links them).

transport.description: Last-saved transport snapshot (position, loop region). state is saved as "stopped".
